{{Quote|To Dathomir to meditate on the dark side and train, Count Dooku now sends his Acolytes. Travel there and defeat one, you must, yes.|Yoda|<ref name="CWA" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] sent his [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to meditate on the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. In order to stop this, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] sent a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] there on a '''mission''' to defeat one of Dooku's Acolytes.
